summary: feat(concur): receipts attach falls back to the expense edit page when the receipt-images API 404s
reason: POST /receiptimages/v1/{expense_id} returns HTTP 404 on this tenant, so receipts could not be attached from the CLI. Uploading through the expense edit page's file input attaches the receipt immediately.
validated_outcome: Unit tests cover file validation, the 404 hint without --report-id, the happy path, an expense that already has a receipt, and an upload that never appears. Live against a real tenant: attaching a PDF to a draft-report expense set receiptImageId within seconds and a second attach was refused. After review, the upload requires the requested expense's edit path in the page URL, both when a slow page open is tolerated and immediately before uploading. Re-run live on the revised code: the receipt attached to the requested expense only, and a second attach was refused.
